name: Heuristic BVH Construction (Top-Down with Plane-Sweep)
definition: A heuristic method for constructing a Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) using a recursive top-down approach, optimizing for a cost function involving surface area and object count, rather than seeking the mathematically optimal partition which is computationally infeasible.
summary: Heuristic BVH Construction (Top-Down with Plane-Sweep) recursively builds a Bounding Volume Hierarchy by using a plane-sweep strategy to find near-optimal splits, distinguishing itself from bottom-up methods by generally yielding better BVH quality.
